outcome: A project can replace and roll back its workflow template with preview and audit, read packed capability docs and fixtures, schedule recurring and event-triggered steps, request and complete reviews, accept or reject handoffs without applying rejected events, and read overloaded-role and release-readiness rollups
acceptance: replacing a project workflow template shows a preview of changed stages and steps and writes an audit event
future-only replacement leaves active runs on the previous template
active-run migration remaps open runs onto the new template
a built-in capability includes documentation and a conformance fixture
a recurring step is scheduled again after it completes
an event-triggered step stays queued until its event arrives
a review request can be created and completed as role-scoped events
accepting a handoff changes owner in the same transition
rejecting a handoff records the rejection and does not change owner
a wrong-role handoff does not change state
project rollups show overloaded roles and release readiness
customers cannot replace templates, manage reviews, or accept handoffs
inScope: template replace preview, future-only and active-run migration, rollback, import and export
packed capability documentation and conformance fixtures
handoff accept and reject with transition rejection records
assumptions: clone, select, gates, approvals, pause, resume, retry, and reassign already exist
built-in templates stay immutable; customization uses clone or import
